name: IEC look-ahead carry generator (CPG)
summary: IEC element marked CPG that computes carries for several adder stages at once to speed up arithmetic.
description: The CPG qualifier identifies a look-ahead carry generator. It takes carry generate and carry propagate signals from several adder or ALU stages and produces their carry inputs in parallel, avoiding the delay of a rippling carry chain.

On block diagrams of arithmetic sections the CPG sits beside a row of ALUs, with generate and propagate lines going in and carry lines coming out. Recognising it explains why carries do not pass directly from one ALU to the next.

The symbol does not indicate how many stages it serves; count the input groups or refer to the device data. Label the carry input and output ordering explicitly so the arithmetic stages cannot be connected in the wrong significance order.
readingNotes: Generate and propagate lines come from each arithmetic stage.
Carries return to each stage in parallel.
drawingChecklist: Label generate, propagate and carry lines per stage.
distinction: A ripple-carry arrangement chains CO to CI directly with no CPG element.
